references.text: Moses' face also shone after speaking with God, which resembles the transfiguration of Jesus.
Daniel's vision of a man clothed in linen, whose face shone like lightning, can be connected to Jesus' radiant appearance.
The angel's appearance, like lightning and clothes white as snow at Jesus' tomb, recalls the transfiguration of Jesus.
John's revelation of Jesus, where his face shone like the sun in all its power, has parallels with the transfiguration.
